description: Detach an organization channel from an agent, ending the binding attach_channel made. The channel stays in the organization for other agents, and the agent stops receiving its events. Detaching a channel that is not attached changes nothing. Slack is the exception: the agent owns its Slack app, so this tool detaches nothing and returns the step a person takes to remove the app. Requires connecting a Valet account.

channel.description: The name the channel is attached under, from list_channels.

name.description: The agent's name, as list_services shows it: the agent to detach the channel from.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the agent belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: detach_channel

agent.description: Name of the agent the call acted on.

already.description: True when the channel was not attached to the agent, so nothing changed. Absent when this call detached it.

attached.description: Always false: the agent no longer holds the channel after the call.

channel.description: Name the channel is attached under, which is the name detach_channel takes.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.
Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

step.description: What the person does to detach a Slack channel, which belongs to the agent: remove its Slack app. Returned instead of a detach result; nothing has changed until they do it.

url.description: Address of the page where the person finishes the step. Absent when the page has no address to give.

title: Detach a channel
